systems-v2-dark.svg: GameState: Menu > RoundAnnounce > RoundActive. Every system is gated on it. Gameplay systems: Player, boss phases, collision, powerups. Feedback systems: Particles, screen shake, HUD. Audio: Synthesized. Driven by SoundEvent. Render: Shapes + bloom, then the CRT WGSL post-process at a quality tier per platform. Output: A native window or a browser canvas
systems-v2-light.svg: GameState: Menu > RoundAnnounce > RoundActive. Every system is gated on it. Gameplay systems: Player, boss phases, collision, powerups. how-v2-dark.svg: Small systems: Small systems, gated on GameState. One system does one thing. Events: Systems talk through events (SoundEvent, DeathEvent). Features stay independent. Render order: The renderer draws shapes with bloom. The CRT shader runs last, at a quality tier per platform. One codebase: The same code builds native and WASM. Only the quality tier changes

learned-v2-dark.svg: ECS over one big loop: Small systems gated on game states and connected by events keep features independent. Custom post-processing: A hand-written WGSL shader (scanlines, vignette, barrel distortion) with quality tiers per platform. WASM is not free: Instant::now() panics in the browser, WebGPU is not ready everywhere, and audio needs the right decoder. Details in WASM_BUILD.md. Headless game tests: A MinimalPlugins app can run real boss and laser systems in cargo test, without a window
learned-v2-light.svg: ECS over one big loop: Small systems gated on game states and connected by events keep features independent. WASM is not free: Instant::now() panics in the browser, WebGPU is not ready everywhere, and audio needs the right decoder. Details in WASM_BUILD.md. Headless game tests: A MinimalPlugins app can run real boss and laser systems in cargo test, without a window
